turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Definitely! Finishing in 1:58 was a huge achievement, and that kind of cardio base definitely helps on the climbing wall. How is Ana doing, by the way? Have you spoken to her much since the wedding?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She's doing great! We chatted on Sunday. They're loving married life. Anyway, I should probably get back to my account manager duties. Talk to you later!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sounds good, Leo. Have a great climb tonight and good luck with the rest of your client calls!
